meta.title: 知识获取平台 UI 视觉方向
meta.summary: 24 个非卡片式微信知识平台视觉参考，覆盖编辑索引、实时信号、频道色谱与知识阅读。

signals.theme: 官方更新优先、精选媒体补充的年轻化知识获取平台
signals.goal: 让用户快速发现最新动态，并进一步完成可信、可追溯的知识阅读
signals.audience: 对 AI、科技、娱乐、社会、游戏和英语感兴趣的中国年轻用户
brand_inputs: 当前绿色圆角卡片系统仅作为反例，不延续
signals.palette_direction: 明亮编辑底色；频道色只作细线、边带和状态标识；拒绝大面积渐变

items.motif: asymmetrical lead story, thin rules, generous negative space
items.prompt: A refined off-white mobile editorial feed with one dominant lead-story region, two subordinate text rows, razor-thin black dividers, a narrow cobalt category rail, and strong asymmetrical whitespace. Single vertical 9:16 mobile product-design reference showing one coherent interface state. No collage, no grid of multiple screens, no contact sheet, no split panels, no scrapbook. No readable words, no numbers, no logos, no brand marks, no real user data. Use abstract typographic bars and neutral image placeholders only. No rounded card containers, no floating card stack, no heavy gradient, no cyberpunk neon overload. Young, credible, bright editorial art direction for a Chinese WeChat knowledge product.
items.audienceCue: Chinese young adults who want useful current knowledge without noisy scrolling.
items.focusedOutputType: WeChat mini-program visual system and mobile editorial feed
